name: Parilyne
source:
A totally normal, unremarkable girl who happens to be a singularity--a person who doesn't exist in any other parallel universes. This is a logic error in the eyes of the laws of the universe, marking her for deletion. The November Magician Nova, who is supposed to be the one deleting her, decides to fight against fate and attempt to save her.

Taking life as it comes and not particularly having a passion for anything, Parilyne gradually loses her identity as the universe attempts to erase her. Losing awareness and not even knowing if she wants to be saved, Parilyne's journey will change both her and the people around her.

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/2819494.parilyne]official bio[/url]]
